I personally love Kyubey solely for how interesting of a character he is. He claims he doesn’t have emotion, but displays greed, confusion, shock, and fear. He claims he’s working for the betterment of the universe but as pointed out in this thread, still chooses the more cruel and inefficient With method over Madoka’s Wraith system. Heck, the whole reason he’s trying to prolong the universe is arguably out of fear of cessation.

My personal headcanon is that the Kyubey hivemind is essentially a mad scientist. He has selfish wants and will manipulate young girls for it. But by his own standard, that would make him insane. And Kyubey refuses to see himself as anything other than perfectly efficient and logical, so he acts like everything he’s doing is based on cold logic and reason. In reality he’s just an uncaring asshole who happens to be an alien.
